messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Clara Liu <clara.liu@bluebay.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC wrap: throughput & cost delta — quick ask for quote/call

Hi Clara —

Thanks again for running the 3-week POC with us. Quick consolidated recap from our side (details attached):

- Workload: product search re-ranking + short-form generation across 8M monthly requests (sampled)
- Latency: 95p generation latency reduced from 420ms -> 245ms (~42% improvement)
- Throughput: peak steady-state throughput improved ~2.1x on the same GPU mix thanks to batching + prefix caching
- Unit cost: estimated token cost per request reduced ~58% (quantization + smarter routing for tail traffic)
- Error rate: generation error/timeout events down from 0.9% -> 0.12%

These materially changed the economics of your production run-rate — we put together a short one-pager and token-economics CSV attached for your procurement/finance folks.

Small ask: would BlueBay be open to a 10-minute recorded reference (one-line quote + permission to use the metrics above) we can share in a case study and on the marketplace? If that's too much, a single-sentence attribution is perfect.

Proposed 10-minute agenda (if helpful): 1) confirm metrics 2) a single line quote 3) permission to publish.

Can you let me know if Clara or someone on your team can do this this week? Happy to be flexible — we can also accept an email one-liner.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

—
Markus Klein
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0122
